arxiv-1903-04618.title: Measurement of V ​ H VH , H → b ​ b ¯ H\to b\bar{b} production as a function of the vector-boson transverse momentum in 13 TeV p ​ p pp collisions with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1903-04618.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1903-04618.description: Abstract Cross-sections of associated production of a Higgs boson decaying into bottom-quark pairs and an electroweak gauge boson, W W or Z Z , decaying into leptons are measured as a function of the gauge boson transverse momentum. The measurements are performed in kinematic fiducial volumes defined in the ‘simplified template cross-section’ framework. The results are obtained using 79.

arxiv-2008-04176.title: A Large-scale Study of Security Vulnerability Support on Developer Q&A Websites CCS: Security and privacy Software security engineering CCS: General and reference Empirical studies
arxiv-2008-04176.creator: Triet Huynh Minh Le, Roland Croft, David Hin, M. Ali Babar
arxiv-2008-04176.description: Abstract . Context : Security Vulnerabilities (SVs) pose many serious threats to software systems. Developers usually seek solutions to addressing these SVs on developer Question and Answer (Q&A) websites. However, there is still little known about on-going SV-specific discussions on different developer Q&A sites.

arxiv-2103-16216.title: A Regulatory System for Optimal Legal Transaction Throughput in Cryptocurrency Blockchains Conference: ; ; CCS: Security and privacy Distributed systems security CCS: Applied computing Electronic commerce CCS: Applied computing Digital cash CCS: Applied computing Secure online transactions CCS: Appl
arxiv-2103-16216.creator: Aditya Ahuja, Vinay J. Ribeiro, Ranjan Pal
arxiv-2103-16216.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Aditya Ahuja, Vinay J. Ribeiro, Ranjan Pal. Permissionless blockchain consensus protocols have been designed primarily for defining decentralized economies for the commercial trade of assets, both virtual and physical, using cryptocurrencies. In most instances, the assets being traded are regulated , which mandates that the legal right to their trade and their trade value are determined by the governmental regulator of the jurisdiction in which the trade occurs.

arxiv-2105-04554.title: Local approximate Gaussian process regression for data-driven constitutive laws: Development and comparison with neural networks
arxiv-2105-04554.creator: Jan Niklas Fuhg, Michele Marino, Nikolaos Bouklas
arxiv-2105-04554.description: Abstract Hierarchical computational methods for multiscale mechanics such as the FE 2 \mathrm{FE}^{2} and FE-FFT methods are generally accompanied by high computational costs. Data-driven approaches are able to speed the process up significantly by enabling to incorporate the effective micromechanical response in macroscale simulations without the need of performing additional computations at each Gauss point explicitly.

arxiv-2109-15145.title: Inequalities for Plane Partitions
arxiv-2109-15145.creator: Bernhard Heim, Markus Neuhauser, Robert Tröger
arxiv-2109-15145.description: Abstract . Inequalities are important features in the context of sequences of numbers and polynomials. The Bessenrodt–Ono inequality for partition numbers and Nekrasov–Okounkov polynomials has only recently been discovered. In this paper we study the log-concavity (Turán inequality) and Bessenrodt–Ono inequality for plane partitions and their polynomization. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 05A17, 11P82; Secondary 05A20 1.

arxiv-2405-15760.title: GPT is Not an Annotator: The Necessity of Human Annotation in Fairness Benchmark Construction
arxiv-2405-15760.creator: Virginia K. Felkner, Jennifer A. Thompson, Jonathan May
arxiv-2405-15760.description: Abstract Social biases in LLMs are usually measured via bias benchmark datasets. Current benchmarks have limitations in scope, grounding, quality, and human effort required. Previous work has shown success with a community-sourced, rather than crowd-sourced, approach to benchmark development. However, this work still required considerable effort from annotators with relevant lived experience. This paper explores whether an LLM (specifically, GPT-3.

arxiv-2408-06493.title: Out of the Loop: Structural Approximation of Optimisation Landscapes and non-Iterative Quantum Optimisation
arxiv-2408-06493.creator: Tom Krüger, Wolfgang Mauerer
arxiv-2408-06493.description: Abstract The Quantum Approximate Optimisation Algorithm ( qaoa ) is a widely studied quantum-classical iterative heuristic for combinatorial optimisation. While qaoa targets problems in complexity class NP , the classical optimisation procedure required in every iteration is itself known to be NP -hard.

arxiv-2512-02996.title: Structured Clifford+T Circuits for Efficient Generation of Quantum Chaos
arxiv-2512-02996.creator: Asim Sharma, Avah Banerjee
arxiv-2512-02996.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Asim Sharma, Avah Banerjee. We investigate the emergence of quantum chaos and unitary T–design behavior in derandomized Clifford+ T T circuits using causal cover architectures. Motivated by the need for deterministic constructions that can exhibit chaotic behavior across diverse quantum hardware platforms, we explore deterministic Clifford circuit architectures (random Clifford circuits with causal cover, bitonic sorting networks, and permutation-based routing circuits) to drive quantum circuits toward Wigner–Dyson (WD) entanglement spectrum statistics and OTOC decay.

arxiv-2512-10656.title: Token Sample Complexity of Attention
arxiv-2512-10656.creator: Léa Bohbot Cyril Letrouit Gabriel Peyré ENS, PSL Univ. LMO, Univ. Paris-Saclay, CNRS CNRS, ENS, PSL Univ. François-Xavier Vialard LIGM, Univ. Gustave Eiffel, CNRS
arxiv-2512-10656.description: Abstract As context windows in large language models continue to expand, it is essential to characterize how attention behaves at extreme sequence lengths. We introduce token-sample complexity: the rate at which attention computed on n n tokens converges to its infinite-token limit.

arxiv-2512-20655.title: MaskOpt: A Large-Scale Mask Optimization Dataset to Advance AI in Integrated Circuit Manufacturing
arxiv-2512-20655.creator: Yuting Hu, Lei Zhuang, Hua Xiang, Jinjun Xiong, Gi-Joon Nam, [0.6em] University at Buffalo, Buffalo, NY, USA
arxiv-2512-20655.description: Abstract As integrated circuit (IC) dimensions shrink below the lithographic wavelength, optical lithography faces growing challenges from diffraction and process variability. Model-based optical proximity correction (OPC) and inverse lithography technique (ILT) remain indispensable but computationally expensive, requiring repeated simulations that limit scalability.

pmc-10643139.title: Aberrant gene activation in synovial sarcoma relies on SSX specificity and increased PRC1.1 stability
pmc-10643139.creator: Nezha S. Benabdallah, Vineet Dalal, R. Wilder Scott, Fady Marcous, Afroditi Sotiriou, Felix K. F. Kommoss, Anastasija Pejkovska, Ludmila Gaspar, Lena Wagner, Francisco J. Sánchez-Rivera, Monica Ta, Shelby Thornton, Torsten O. Nielsen, T. Michael Underhill, Ana Banito
pmc-10643139.description: The SS18-SSX fusion drives oncogenic transformation in synovial sarcoma by bridging SS18, a member of the mSWI/SNF (BAF) complex, to Polycomb repressive complex 1 (PRC1) target genes. Here we show that the ability of SS18-SSX to occupy H2AK119ub1-rich regions is an intrinsic property of its SSX C terminus, which can be exploited by fusion to transcriptional regulators beyond SS18.

pmc-12653785.title: Mandibular Lateral Displacement in Growing Patients: Etiopathogenesis, Prophylaxis, and Early Treatment—A Literature Review
pmc-12653785.creator: Karolina Kowalska, Agnieszka Machorowska-Pieniążek, Liliana Szyszka-Sommerfeld, Krzysztof Woźniak
pmc-12653785.description: Background: Mandibular lateral displacement is a common functional occlusal disorder that may occur independently or in conjunction with other types of malocclusion. Substantial evidence indicates that in growing patients, mandibular lateral displacement can have a significant negative impact on the development of both the morphology and function of the stomatognathic system.

pmc-13077252.title: Thoracic paravertebral block with liposomal bupivacaine versus ropivacaine for postoperative analgesia in thoracic surgery: a randomized controlled study
pmc-13077252.creator: Yicheng Sun, Bin Chen, Tao Liu, Lu Wang, Guangkuo Gao, Wanli Kang, Wei Liu
pmc-13077252.description: BackgroundParavertebral block is a highly effective regional analgesic technique for thoracic surgery. Liposomal bupivacaine (LB) significantly extends the duration of analgesia. However, the efficacy of LB for thoracic paravertebral block (TPVB) in patients undergoing video-assisted thoracic surgery (VATS) remains unclear. This trial aimed to evaluate the analgesic efficacy of TPVB with LB following VATS.

pmc-13183106.title: Network pharmacology and Mendelian randomization analysis to unravel the mechanism of Qingwen Baidu Decoction in sepsis treatment
pmc-13183106.creator: Weina Wang, Yushu Ruan, Xiaobing Wu, Lili Li, Na Liu, Yuanyuan Li
pmc-13183106.description: The aim of this study was to evaluate the potential components and targets of Qingwen Baidu Decoction (QBD) for sepsis by integrating a comprehensive strategy of network pharmacology and Mendelian randomization (MR). Systematically search the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology, HERB, and Stitch databases for potential active ingredients and therapeutic targets of QBD.

pmc-13549320.title: Dermoscopic CIELab Colorimetry for Longitudinal Monitoring of Fixed Target Lesions in Psoriasis: Objective Quantification of Background Color and Vascular Density
pmc-13549320.creator: Ziyuan Tian, Yang Han, Zhou Zhuang, Ke Xue, Yong Cui
pmc-13549320.description: PurposeObjective longitudinal monitoring of a single psoriasis lesion remains underdeveloped. We evaluated the methodological feasibility of a quantitative fixed-target-lesion framework that derives continuous surface-color and vascular signals from dermoscopy, using CIELab as the measurement space rather than the clinical endpoint.Patients and MethodsThis single-center retrospective longitudinal study included 28 patients with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis receiving biologic therapy (176 dermoscopic observations).

uslaw-usc-t7-s1638d.title: 7 U.S.C. § 1638d — Applicability
uslaw-usc-t7-s1638d.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s1638d.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 38 (Distribution And Marketing Of Agricultural Products); Subchapter IV (Country Of Origin Labeling). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. This subchapter shall apply to the retail sale of a covered commodity beginning September 30, 2008, except for “farm-raised fish” and “wild fish” which shall be September 30, 2004.
